title: Sweden's Mightiest Warship Sank On Its First Trip 🚢
caption:
A brand new warship sank on its very first trip 🚢
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1628 Sweden's warship Vasa heeled over in a light gust and sank after barely over a kilometre, because its centre of gravity was too high. It lay on the seabed for over 300 years and was raised in 1961. Today it is a museum in Stockholm.
Would you have sailed on it? 👇
first_comment: Over 300 years underwater and it is now one of the best preserved ships in the world. Worth a visit? 🚢👇
